job_spec.purpose: el1011-hbm-smh round 3 (textbook audit class 1 + physical spec, el1011-hbm-smh.log): hardened SM-tile sub-element tcl (8 BF16 lanes, 8.4k flops); own clock tree + reset relay, pin-faced for straight <= 22 um hops in the 587.52 x 1080 tile; routes M2-M6 (tile owns M7); PD 0.45, HM 0. Benches: tile lockstep under OT_SMH_HIER (exact PASS + 0 lockstep mismatches; total cycles = 8244 + 2 from the gather relays, recorded) + late32/hold0 mutants. | -nb: no bench stage on the hardened child (owner 10-11: exactness gates ADOPTION, never the rebuild; the tile job carries the lockstep bench + mutants). | -ior: abutting ports referenced to the child's own register clock pin (--io-ref); the 4fd52d6ff children budgeted them against a fixed 300 ps neighbour latency (pt_w -171 ps input hold at u_rln, tcl output-port hold flood). | -ck sibling: no --io-ref (CTS segfault risk), calibrated neighbour latency. | -cal: calibrate runs CTS WITHOUT repair (SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING=1, the OT_CAL_CTS_ONLY precedent) so the loop measures this child's own insertion and the route's IO SDC uses it (CK_SS_MEAN / CK_FF_MEAN); the -ck runs used a fixed 470 / 280 ps for every child -> output-port hold floods (tcl -107 ps sum_o, tct -118 ps otag, pte 3,531 x -1.3 ps bout): wrong IO budget, no fanout net. | hb45: LOCAL ADDITION on a class-free child (<=15k sinks, calibrated IO, no fanout net): the -cal route's CTS repair needed more than the 20 % instance budget only to pad shallow zero/low-logic flop pairs to the loop's 25 ps margin (real hold: see job notes).
